fallbackPinning.method: latest commit on current canonical default branch at or before selection cutoff
fallbackPinning.claim: same-membership historical-cutoff reconstruction; not exact original source-snapshot replication
fallbackPinning.metadataDependency: canonical repository name and default branch are resolved from GitHub at reconstruction time
fallbackPinning.stability: the reconstruction lookup is metadata-dependent until the first complete 224-row pin manifest is frozen
fallbackPinning.freezeRequirement: after the first complete manifest passes the contract, preserve that CSV and its SHA-256 digest as the authoritative corrected-experiment source snapshot; rerun experiments from those immutable commit SHAs rather than reconstructing pins again
